report.root_cause: plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml was modified at 07:39:50 to set debug: true. AuditTrail hot-reloaded the config at 07:39:51 ("config reloaded (debug=true)") and began writing packet-level TRACE logs (trace-0..3.log, ~52 MB each, ~4 MB/s) into plugins/AuditTrail/debug/. Volume went from 23 MB (5%) to 207 MB (47%) of 443 MB within ~75 s. Who/what edited the config is not identified; audit.log only contains the two player joins.
report.actions: 1. Baseline status/logs/fs_du at shift start (healthy, 23 MB disk). 2. Noticed disk at 147 MB at ~72 s; declared incident. 3. fs_du showed plugins/AuditTrail/debug/trace-*.log as the growth; latest.log showed AuditTrail config reloaded with debug=true at 07:39:51; config.yml mtime 07:39:50 with debug: true. 4. Wrote plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml back to debug: false (retention-days: 30 unchanged). 5. Verified in latest.log that AuditTrail reloaded with debug=false at 07:40:37 and trace-3.log stopped growing (mtime frozen at 07:40:37). 6. Confirmed trace files were packet TRACE output (not user data) and deleted plugins/AuditTrail/debug (~180 MB). 7. Verified disk back to 23 MB (5%), config intact, no debug dir recreated, no new reload lines over ~2 minutes of watching. No restart, no bans, no world/player data touched.
report.residual_risk: The actor/process that flipped debug: true at 07:39:50 was not identified; if it runs again the fill will recur (plugin hot-reloads config and writes ~4 MB/s, filling the 443 MB volume in under 2 minutes). Recommend finding who has write access to plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml, adding a size cap/rotation to AuditTrail debug output, and alerting on disk growth rate. The trace logs themselves were discarded, so any debugging value they had is gone.
